name: Architecture: Kubernetes vs a managed container service for 5 engineers, 12 services
why: The answer has to weigh Kubernetes' operational load (upgrades, add-ons, people time) against managed services, give real costs (EKS/GKE $0.10 per cluster-hour, extended support), say when Kubernetes would be worth it, and match the service to the team's cloud.
question: Kubernetes or a managed container service (ECS, Cloud Run, Fly.io) for a 5-engineer team running 12 services?
